page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density parallel processing and machine learning inference. Powered by an x86_64 architecture featuring 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs and 384 GB of system memory (4 GB per vCPU), this host provides strong multi-threaded compute capability managed via a KVM hypervisor platform.

The primary accelerator component of the ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge incorporates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. This multi-GPU setup provides specialized acceleration for lower-precision operations like INT8, INT4, and FP16. High-throughput data transfer across distributed environments is supported by a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

A notable configuration aspect is the complete absence of local storage on the host, requiring reliance on attached cloud block storage for persistent data management. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio paired with quad NVIDIA T4 accelerators makes this server a cost-effective platform for AI inference pipelines, multi-stream video transcoding, and deep learning model evaluations without paying for unused local disk overhead.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a high-density, bare-metal GPU-accelerated instance built on an x86_64 architecture. Powered by 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs and 384 GB of system memory, the host offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Its primary compute accelerator consists of four NVIDIA T4 GPUs providing 64 GB of aggregated VRAM, optimized for low-precision matrix operations and deep learning inference. The server features a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth to support sustained network traffic. However, the instance includes no integrated local storage, necessitating external network-attached storage for persistent operational data. This configuration offers a resource-dense profile for multi-stream video transcoding, AI inference, deep learning model evaluation, and graphical rendering workloads.
